title: De-Googled GrapheneOS is coming to Motorola’s foldables next year
summary: GrapheneOS, a privacy-focused open-source Android version, will officially support Motorola smartphones beginning next year, initially with flagship models before expanding to the Razr Fold and Razr Ultra foldables. The Razr Ultra would become the first flip phone to officially run the platform, signaling growing adoption of privacy-first mobile operating systems.
content:
The Razr Ultra line is among those due to receive GrapheneOS support next year. | Photo: Allison Johnson / The Verge	

GrapheneOS, an open source version of Android that prioritizes security and privacy, has detailed its plans for supporting Motorola smartphones. Official support is set to arrive next year, starting with traditional flagships, before rolling out to Motorola's foldable phones and perhaps cheaper models, eventually. 
In a Mastodon thread, the GrapheneOS Foundation announced that it will initially support a Motorola slab flagship phone, but will later support both Razr Fold and Razr Ultra foldables - the latter of which would be the first flip phone to officially run GrapheneOS.

zh.title: 去谷歌化的GrapheneOS明年将登陆摩托罗拉可折叠手机
zh.summary: 隐私为中心的开源安卓系统GrapheneOS将从明年开始正式支持摩托罗拉智能手机，首先支持旗舰机型，随后扩展到Razr Fold和Razr Ultra可折叠手机。Razr Ultra将成为首款正式运行该平台的翻盖手机，标志着隐私第一的移动操作系统采用率不断提高。

title: Review: Chuwi's $449 Unibook laptop is a funhouse-mirror MacBook Neo
summary: Chuwi's $449 Unibook laptop attempts to replicate MacBook design at a budget price point but delivers what reviewers describe as a quirky and compromised user experience. The laptop targets budget-conscious users with patience to tolerate its idiosyncrasies for an affordable alternative to premium ultrabooks.
content: The Unibook is a weird entry-level laptop for people with patience.

zh.title: 评测：驱动的449美元Unibook笔记本是MacBook的廉价山寨版
zh.summary: 驱动的449美元Unibook笔记本试图以低价复制MacBook设计，但评测人士指出其提供了古怪且妥协的用户体验。这款笔记本面向预算有限且有耐心容忍其特殊之处的消费者，作为高端超极本的经济型替代品。

title: Humanoid robots smash Usain Bolt’s 100-meter record
summary: Chinese humanoid robots have broken Usain Bolt's 17-year-old 100-meter world record at the World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing, with Tiangong Ultra completing the distance in 9.39 seconds compared to Bolt's 9.58-second mark from 2009. The achievement highlights rapid advancement in bipedal robotics, with the annual competition attracting 2,056 robots from 16 countries.
content:
Tiangong Ultra (left) also broke the 400 meter world record during this year’s World Humanoid Robot Games. | Image: Lintao Zhang/Getty Images	

The 9.58-second 100-meter dash record set by Usain Bolt in 2009 has been outpaced by Chinese robots participating at the World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing. In a preliminary heat on Saturday, Tiangong Ultra, made by the Beijing Humanoid Robot Innovation ​Center, ran the distance in 9.39 seconds, followed by the Honor-developed Lightning at 9.47 seconds.

zh.title: 人形机器人打破了尤塞恩·博尔特的100米记录
zh.summary: 中国人形机器人在北京世界人形机器人运动会上打破了尤塞恩·博尔特17年前的100米世界纪录，天工Ultra在9.39秒内完成了100米，而博尔特在2009年创造的记录是9.58秒。这一成就突显了双足机器人的快速发展，年度竞赛吸引了来自16个国家的2056个机器人参加。
